keyword_matches.hello: Hello! Welcome to Joy Water Sports! I'm here to help with your rides, calculated rates, or booking details. What's on your mind today?

keyword_matches.date: We are open and operating all days! All days of the week, including Sundays and holidays, are available from 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM. Just let me know when you'd like to book!
keyword_matches.day: Yes, we operates 7 days a week, 365 days a year (weather permitting)! All days are open for booking. Sessions run daily from 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM.
keyword_matches.time: Our ocean sessions start at 9:30 AM and wrap up around 6:00 PM daily. This is the optimal window for the best sunlight and waves!
keyword_matches.who: We are Joy Water Sports, your premium destination for safe, thrilling, and extremely memorable watersports on Varkala beach.
keyword_matches.safety: Safety is our highest priority! We use certified equipment, premium life vests, and have highly trained double-certified rescue teams on high alert. You do not need to know swimming!
keyword_matches.swim: No swimming skills are required for any of our water sports! We provide top-of-the-line buoyant life jackets, and our trained captains are right by your side during the entire experience.
